name: depart.cloud
description: Social hub for multiplayer OMSI 2. Elixir backend orchestrates servers, provides in-depth user administration, and analyses data from a hand-rolled game server to provide stats to players.

name: Relayed
description: LSP-based live coding collaboration: any editor, from Helix to VS Code. CRDTs (conflict-free replicated data types), file-tree syncing and compressed snapshots are used to achieve consistency.

name: PaperTrail
description: A study planner built with Go and htmx on top of Ollama. It works backwards from exam past-papers and uploaded lecture slides to create prioritised tasks and daily study plans.

name: Digifilm
description: Simple photography portfolio built with Cloudflare technologies. Uses R2 for image buckets, KV for album data. Dynamic with no server fees :)

name: passc
description: CLI secrets manager with configurable libsodium encryption. Secure and reliable but perhaps not a Bitwarden replacement.

name: Shutter
description: An image upload service with a user dashboard, custom domain support, and Discord/ShareX integration.

name: Slicer
description: An initial attempt at a scalable chat platform. Learned to love and hate Kubernetes.
